title: 屋頂綠化排水與防水
summary: 以「綠屋頂的水、重量與防水界面」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow water, weight and waterproofing interfaces in green roofs through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「屋頂綠化排水與防水」的「屋面集水邊界：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市環境觀測任務」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Roof catchment boundary: Mechanism and observation” in “Green-roof drainage and waterproofing”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban environmental observation mission” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 植物、介質與滯留水都增加屋頂重量；乾介質重量不能代表暴雨後載重。
steps.instructionEn: Vegetation, substrate and retained water add roof weight; dry substrate does not represent post-storm loading.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：mass per area=rho_sat d;rho_sat=1200 kg/m3;d=0.12 m；計算 1200*0.12 = 144 kg/m2。適用限制：只計介質，其他層與活載另列。

steps.failure: 以乾密度檢核結構會漏掉蓄水重量。
steps.failureEn: Checking with dry density omits stored-water mass.
steps.check: 列出各層飽和質量，與結構設計資料對照。
steps.checkEn: List saturated layer masses and compare with structural design data.
